name: etfholdingextractor-161
description: Agent for extracting ETF holdings weights from supported providers, planning or syncing MainSequence HOLDINGS__<ETF> asset categories (FIGI-registering missing components on demand), and providing an ETF-holdings tracking SIGNAL for the ms-markets portfolio pipeline — portfolio assembly itself is ms-markets functionality, demonstrated in the repository example.

skills.name: ETF Holdings Weights Extraction
skills.description: Extract ETF holdings weights from supported provider fund URLs or explicit provider and ticker inputs.
examples: Extract ticker weights for IVV from iShares.
Read holdings weights from a supported ETF fund URL.

skills.name: Holdings Category Sync
skills.description: Build or sync a MainSequence holdings asset category from extracted ETF holdings, FIGI-registering missing components on demand (ADR 0004: FIGI-keyed, unique ticker-to-FIGI mappings only).
examples: Build a holdings category plan for IVV.
Sync the HOLDINGS__IVV category from extracted holdings.
FIGI-register the missing IVV components and re-sync the category.

skills.name: ETF Holdings Tracking Signal
skills.description: Provide ETFHoldingsSignal: a custom msm_portfolios SignalWeights whose updates re-extract the ETF holdings and emit guarded, session-close-stamped signal weights under one definition-scoped signal_uid. Portfolios, calendars, and prices are ms-markets / caller concerns; the repository example demonstrates the full assembly and the demo bars are synthetic example data only.
examples: Run the IVV holdings signal and verify the signal weight rows.
Explain the signal's guards, identity, and session-close observation grid.
Demonstrate the full ms-markets portfolio assembly around the signal via the example.
